title: Manage organisation settings
summary: A draft guide for reviewing and updating organisational information that your account is authorised to manage.

blocks.text: Review and update the organisational information your account is authorised to manage. Some settings may affect other users or compliance records, so confirm the impact before saving.

items: Confirm the organisation or workspace you are working in.
Review the current values and the fields your role is permitted to change.
Update only the approved information in the confirmed editable fields.
Save the change and check that the updated values are displayed.

blocks.text: If a field is unavailable, check whether it is read-only or restricted to another role. If saving fails, record the validation message and check the documented field requirements.
